A fiend with dark powers for confusing the enemy. Among the Fiend-Type monsters, this monster boasts considerable force.

extDescription: A genie of the lamp that is at the beck and call of its master.

extDescription: A monster with tremendous power, it destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

extDescription: A monster disguised as a treasure chest that is known to attack the unwary adventurer.
